title: Law to limit removal of public litter baskets
summary: This bill would stop the Sanitation Department from removing a public litter basket solely because someone illegally dumped trash in it. It would require the department to notify the local council member and community board before removing a basket, giving them 10 business days to comment, and to consider those comments before acting. The department would also have to file a quarterly public report on basket counts, removals, reasons and related littering complaints.
